name: codexeni
description: Codexeni lets any MCP-speaking coding harness delegate bounded coding work to another authenticated local coding harness; Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex CLI are the built-in workers.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate bounded coding tasks to a local coding harness.
interface.longDescription: Codexeni is an unofficial, harness-neutral bridge that lets one coding harness orchestrate an authenticated local worker harness for bounded coding and review tasks; Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex CLI are the built-in workers, with more adapters planned. The orchestrator remains responsible for approvals, conflict review, and final verification.
defaultPrompt: Use delegate_discover to see which local coding harnesses are installed, then delegate this bounded coding task to one.
Ask the worker harness to review these files, then verify its findings.
Poll the delegated task and summarize changed files.
